backend/main.mo: Main Internet Computer actor for the Cerebral Physique app, defining data types (exercises, blog posts, memberships, etc.) and state maps, with blob storage and authorization mixins included and data migration on upgrade.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that defines old and new actor types and a run function to initialize the new workoutRoutines map during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and configuration files for the Cerebral Physique React app.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how to build and deploy the app to the Internet Computer, find the live .icp0.io URL, and set up a custom domain.
frontend/DOMAIN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step instructions for connecting a custom domain (cerebralphysique.com) to the Internet Computer deployment via GoDaddy or Cloudflare DNS configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider, and registers the router type.
frontend/src/components/CopyToClipboardC: A reusable button component that copies provided text to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback for older browsers, showing a success/error toast and a temporary checkmark icon.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Admin CRUD interface for managing Amazon affiliate products, with add/edit dialogs, form validation, delete confirmation, and a data table listing all products.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Admin blog management component supporting manual create, edit, publish, and delete operations for blog posts, including SEO fields and URL array inputs for images and videos.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a future breathwork content management component.
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting exercises, with fields for muscle group, equipment type, media URLs, and cues using a form with inline URL array management.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: Admin UI component for viewing and editing muscle group cards (title, description, image URLs) via a dialog form, fetching data from the backend.
frontend/src/components/creator/Nutritio: Admin UI component for creating, editing, publishing, and deleting nutrition articles with support for media URLs and member-only access control.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer component displaying the brand logo, social media links, and navigation columns for Quick Links, Resources, and Legal sections.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with desktop and mobile menus, Internet Identity login/logout handling, and conditional admin/dashboard links.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper that composes the Header, Footer, MusicPlayer, and a router Outlet into a full-page flex column.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button component that initiates a Stripe checkout session for a $24.99/month membership and redirects the user to the Stripe-hosted payment page.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Floating background music player with autoplay-on-first-interaction support, play/pause toggle, mute, and volume control rendered as a fixed bottom-right widget.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control if a token is present and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand-based global music player store and hook managing play/pause state, volume, mute, and an HTMLAudioElement reference, with volume and mute state persisted to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data fetching and mutations, covering admin checks, user profiles, exercises, blog posts, nutrition articles, Amazon products, memberships, and configuration.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind directives, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH colors (including brand deep-blue and neon-purple), custom scrollbar styles, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page presenting the founder's story, brand philosophy, and value proposition sections with hero imagery and styled cards.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Page that fetches and displays Amazon affiliate products in a grid with an affiliate disclosure banner, loading state, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Blog listing page that fetches published post previews and renders them with membership-gated access indicators, admin management link, and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Displays a single blog post by ID, handling loading/not-found states, membership-gated content, and a media gallery supporting images, YouTube, Vimeo, and native video embeds.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Static contact page showing support and general inquiry email addresses along with quick-navigation buttons to key site sections like Programs, Workout Library, and the Store.
Admin-only dashboard page that renders tabbed management panels for exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, nutrition content, and the affiliate store, with auth and permission guards.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSetupPage.tsx: Instructional page guiding admins through connecting a custom domain to the Internet Computer canister, displaying the live canister ID and DNS configuration steps.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Marketing landing page featuring a hero section, a fitness quote banner, and a core-principles card grid highlighting the site's mind-muscle, breathwork, and longevity philosophy.
Displays a single nutrition article by ID with membership-gated full content, loading skeletons, and a media gallery supporting images, YouTube, Vimeo, and native video.
frontend/src/pages/NutritionPage.tsx: Displays a grid of published nutrition article previews with a hero section, locking member-only articles for non-members, and showing an admin link to the creator dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Shows a payment failure screen with options to retry (navigate to dashboard) or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Verifies a Stripe checkout session by ID, invalidates membership cache on success, and displays appropriate success, loading, or error states.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Marketing page listing structured training programs with a hero section, featured program details, and placeholder purchase handlers using toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing membership status and profile info, with a profile setup dialog on first login and options to start a membership checkout or log out.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Displays exercises grouped by muscle group in collapsible sections with image/video support, locking member-only content for non-members and non-admins.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom design system with OKLCH color tokens, border radius variables, Inter font, and custom animations for a fitness app frontend.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a fitness/workout library SPA with muscle group exercises, blogs, nutrition content, and background music, including required exercise illustration image assets.
